global_dependencies: Clock gate: DPORT_I2C_EXT0_CLK_EN (I2C0), DPORT_I2C_EXT1_CLK_EN (I2C1) bits in DPORT_PERIP_CLK_EN_REG (0x3FF000C0).
Corresponding reset bits in DPORT_PERIP_RST_EN_REG (0x3FF000C4) must be de-asserted for the I2C controller to operate.
I2C_SCL_LOW_PERIOD_REG / I2C_SCL_HIGH_PERIOD_REG (bus timing) should be configured based on APB clock before enabling transactions via the command registers (I2C_COMD0-15_REG).
I2C pins (SDA/SCL) must be routed through the GPIO Matrix and configured as open-drain in GPIO_PINn_REG.GPIO_PINn_PAD_DRIVER for proper I2C bus behavior.

NOTE: Several addresses in the manual's own I2C register summary table are printed as short relative offsets (e.g. I2C_CTR_REG = 0x0004, I2C_SR_REG = 0x0008) rather than full absolute addresses like the rest of the table (e.g. 0x3FF53xxx) - this is preserved as printed; treat these as offsets from the I2C0/I2C1 base address (0x3FF53000 / 0x3FF67000) rather than literal absolute addresses, and cross-check against the manual if precision matters.

BIT-POSITION VERIFICATION: I2C_RXFIFO_ST_REG, I2C_INT_RAW_REG, and I2C_INT_STATUS_REG have a few fields flagged 'low' confidence due to overlapping/duplicate field-name text in the diagram - verify these specific fields against the cited PDF page.
